new.title: New zone
new.name: Zone name
new.fileHelp: Relative to the BIND directory; a name is proposed when empty
new.addzone: Add with rndc addzone (named.conf is not edited)
new.addzoneHelp: Needs allow-new-zones yes; named keeps the zone in its NZD database
new.peers: Also on these nodes, as secondaries
new.secondaryPrimariesHelp: One per line, for instance 192.0.2.1 key ddi-read; empty: this node's address
new.serverAddressesHelp: One IP address per line: named sends its queries for the zone there
new.serverNamesHelp: One name server name per line, resolved by named
new.staticStubError: Enter at least one server address or name
new.fileOrPrimaries: Enter a zone file or at least one primary
new.rootOnly: This kind of zone is always the root zone (.)
new.mirrorHelp: Primaries are optional for the root zone only; named needs recursion and DNSSEC validation
new.nsHelp: One per line: a full name (ns1.example.lan.), or a name in the zone with its address (ns1 192.0.2.53). Proposed from the nodes running BIND; empty: dns.default_ns of the settings
new.nsName: Each line is a name server name, optionally followed by its address
new.nsLocalhost: localhost serves the zone to nobody: give the real name servers
new.nsAddress: The address after a name server must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address
new.nsGlue: A name server inside the zone needs its address on the same line

records.rollbackGone: The server no longer holds this plan: it cannot be rolled back from here

editor.deleteBody: Every {{type}} record of {{name}} will be removed through a signed DNS UPDATE.
editor.ownerHelp: Relative to {{zone}}, @ for the apex, or absolute with a final dot
editor.previewPending: Fill the form to see the change

errors.owner: Invalid name, or outside the zone
errors.type: This type cannot be edited here
errors.ttl: TTL must be a whole number of seconds
errors.singleton: A CNAME holds a single value
errors.ipv4: Each value must be an IPv4 address
errors.ipv6: Each value must be an IPv6 address
errors.hostname: Each value must be a host name
errors.txt: Quoted strings of at most 255 characters

detail.staticNote: Static zone: record changes edit its zone file (comments kept, serial bumped, rndc reload with NOTIFY). Converting it to dynamic is a security audit remediation: named then keeps changes in a .jnl journal and the file is edited by hand only between rndc freeze and rndc thaw.
detail.notEditable: Defined in a user file: edit it in named.conf
detail.deleteMessage: The zone is removed from this node through a plan you review before it applies.
detail.deletePeers: Also remove the secondary copies on {{nodes}}
detail.deletePeersHelp: Left in place, they keep retrying transfers from a primary that no longer serves the zone.
